events.title: August 2026 CINLUG Meeting -- MythTV... On Bazzite!
events.description:
CINLUG | Central Indiana Linux Users Group
Summer is the time for projects, so Bernie Hoefer[1] wants to share with CINLUG a project that he's been working on... a project that has its beginning [about 10 years ago](https://www.cinlug.org/2016/11/02/november-9/)!

Bernie has used [MythTV](https://www.mythtv.org/) as a digital video recorder to watch and record over-the-air TV. Yet, his existing system has had problems and it has been long overdue for a change out. Wanting to incorporate [Bazzite
